legend.title: Champion Legend
legend.description: One Champion Legend defines your deck Domain Identity.

champion.title: Chosen Champion
champion.description: One Champion Unit that shares a champion tag with your Legend and matches Domain Identity.

mainDeck.title: Main Deck
mainDeck.description: At least 39 Main Deck cards. With your Chosen Champion, your playable deck is 40 cards.

runes.title: Rune Deck
runes.description: Exactly 12 Rune cards matching your Legend Domain Identity. Split freely across your Legend two domains.

battlefields.title: Battlefields
battlefields.description: Exactly 3 Battlefield cards with unique names.

sideboard.title: Sideboard
sideboard.description: Up to 10 Main Deck cards. Signature cards cannot be sideboarded.

constraints.message: All cards in Main Deck, Rune Deck, Battlefields, Sideboard, and Chosen Champion must match your Legend Domain Identity.
Chosen Champion must share at least one champion tag with your Legend.
Chosen Champion must be a Champion Unit (supertype: Champion).
At most 3 Signature cards total in the Main Deck, matching Legend champion tags.
Signature cards cannot be added to the sideboard.
Each Battlefield name may appear at most once.
Your deck can have any number of cards named Spiderling.
